# Community teams statistics

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Each community team's patients in a bed, and those with a discharge date.

## What is on the screen

1. Statistics views. Network, Compare, Services, Wards, EDs, Teams and Weekly.
2. Teams by service. How many of each service's team patients are in a bed.
3. Teams with someone in a bed. Only teams with someone in a bed are listed. Show all lists every team.

## On a phone

- Teams. With patients lists the teams with someone in a bed. All teams lists every team.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
